encoding.bigint: {"$bigint": "<decimal>"} is an integer written by a native client (yrs Any::BigInt). A plain JSON number is a JS number (Any::Number). Readers accept both, and every comparison is by numeric value.
encoding.rows: A layout another client saved beyond this client's limits (12 widgets, 4 per row, row heights 240 to 1200). Readers show the first 12 widgets in stored order, split a row of more than 4 into rows of at most 4 (spill ids "<row id>:<n>") and clamp heights. Writers never drop a stored widget: the widgets beyond the first 12 stay stored after the written rows, each in its stored row object with only its hidden widgets; a row whose first widgets are shown keeps its hidden rest under "<row id>:rest".
encoding.stored: The layout-settings map as another client left it.
encoding.parsed: Optional. What every client reads from stored, in the persisted snake_case shape.
encoding.write: The typed value this client submits for the named top-level keys, in the persisted shape (the rows it shows, after an edit). Each client parses it into its own typed model before writing.
encoding.writtenKeys: Exactly the top-level keys the write may touch.
encoding.expected: The stored map after the write. Key order is irrelevant.
